population.SU(2) + 1 doublet: SO(2) = U(1): no Weyl reflection beyond the manifest U(1), so nothing to test

controls.positive: Tr(1) at q^2, the flavour currents, re-expands as the SO(2N_f) adjoint, and at N=2* as the USp(2) adjoint μ^-2 + 1 + μ^2
controls.negative: the odd-m traces without the det^(-m/2) twist are not W(D_N_f)-invariant; U(1) with three charge-1 hypers (complex, no enhancement) fails the W(D_3) test; at N=2* the traces with m ≠ 0 without the μ^(-m) twist are not μ ↦ μ^-1 invariant

checks.name: SU(2) + 2 doublets: positive control — Tr(1) at q^2 (the flavour currents) is the SO(4) adjoint [(1, -1), (1, 1)] after re-expansion

SU(2) + 2 doublets: the traces of 6 window sections, twisted by det^(-m/2), are W(D_2)-invariant at every one of their 12 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings) and lift exactly to Spin(4) characters

SU(2) + 2 doublets: the pairings I(a, b) of 36 pairs of window sections, twisted by det^((m_a - m_b)/2), are W(D_2)-invariant at every one of their 62 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings) and lift exactly to Spin(4) characters

SU(2) + 2 doublets: the structure constants of 18 products with m_a + m_b <= 3, twisted by det^((m_c - m_a - m_b)/2), are W(D_2)-invariant at every one of their 29 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings) and lift exactly to Spin(4) characters
SU(2) + 2 doublets: negative control — without the det^(-m/2) twist the odd-m traces are not W(D_2)-invariant (4 of 4 orders fail)
SU(2) + 3 doublets: positive control — Tr(1) at q^2 (the flavour currents) is the SO(6) adjoint [(1, 1, 0)] after re-expansion

SU(2) + 3 doublets: the traces of 2 window sections, twisted by det^(-m/2), are W(D_3)-invariant at every one of their 5 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings) and lift exactly to Spin(6) characters

SU(2) + 3 doublets: the pairings I(a, b) of 4 pairs of window sections, twisted by det^((m_a - m_b)/2), are W(D_3)-invariant at every one of their 10 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings) and lift exactly to Spin(6) characters

SU(2) + 3 doublets: the structure constants of 3 products with m_a + m_b <= 2, twisted by det^((m_c - m_a - m_b)/2), are W(D_3)-invariant at every one of their 3 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings) and lift exactly to Spin(6) characters
SU(2) + 3 doublets: negative control — without the det^(-m/2) twist the odd-m traces are not W(D_3)-invariant (2 of 2 orders fail)
SU(2) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): positive control — Tr(1) at q^2 (the flavour currents) is the USp(2) adjoint μ^-2 + 1 + μ^2

SU(2) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): the traces of 6 window sections, twisted by μ^(-m), are integral and invariant under μ ↦ μ^-1 — USp(2) characters — at every one of their 11 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings)

SU(2) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): the pairings I(a, b) of 36 pairs of window sections, twisted by μ^(m_a - m_b), are integral and invariant under μ ↦ μ^-1 — USp(2) characters — at every one of their 63 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings)

SU(2) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): the structure constants of 14 products with m_a + m_b <= 2, twisted by μ^(m_c - m_a - m_b), are integral and invariant under μ ↦ μ^-1 — USp(2) characters — at every one of their 33 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings)
SU(2) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): negative control — without the μ^(-m) twist the traces of the sections with m ≠ 0 are not USp(2) characters (7 of 7 orders fail)
SO(3) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): positive control — Tr(1) at q^2 (the flavour currents) is the USp(2) adjoint μ^-2 + 1 + μ^2

SO(3) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): the traces of 6 window sections, twisted by μ^(-m), are integral and invariant under μ ↦ μ^-1 — USp(2) characters — at every one of their 16 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings)

SO(3) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): the pairings I(a, b) of 36 pairs of window sections, twisted by μ^(m_a - m_b), are integral and invariant under μ ↦ μ^-1 — USp(2) characters — at every one of their 75 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings)

SO(3) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): the structure constants of 14 products with m_a + m_b <= 1, twisted by μ^(m_c - m_a - m_b), are integral and invariant under μ ↦ μ^-1 — USp(2) characters — at every one of their 36 nonzero orders (through q^4 for traces and pairings)
SO(3) + adjoint (N=2*), USp(2): negative control — without the μ^(-m) twist the traces of the sections with m ≠ 0 are not USp(2) characters (8 of 8 orders fail)
negative control — U(1) with three charge-1 hypers (a complex representation, flavour U(3) with no enhancement) fails the same W(D_3) test: its Schur index is not invariant at q^[2, 4]
